lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Leather jacket gleaming, three trillion in the vault

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Every data center running CUDA by default

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: H100s, Blackwell chips, I architect the brain

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You're bragging about crowd size, I'm building the domain

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Tariffs on my wafers? Man, Taiwan holds the crown

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Pull the plug on silicon, your Truth Social goes down

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: From gaming rigs to sovereign clouds, I'm printing golden flops

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: While you're selling golden sneakers at your campaign stops!

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Listen Jensen, nice jacket, really, very cute

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: But you're nothing when you're standing next to my red tie and suit

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: I built towers, I won twice, the greatest ever seen

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your little computer chips need my energy machine!

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Drill baby drill, yeah, we power up the grid

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Without American electricity, you can't run a single bid

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: We're putting huge tariffs on it, bring the factories back home

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: You may rule the GPU, pal, but I sit on the throne!

lines.speaker: both
lines.text: Silicon and power, who controls the world stage?

lines.speaker: both
lines.text: Blackwell vs Mar-a-Lago, titans of the age!
